gloss: this person and that; anyone and everyone

definitions.gloss: this person and that; anyone and everyone; whoever
definitions.explanation: Refers indiscriminately to various people without specifying who. Often used with なく or かまわず to express doing something without regard to who is involved.

examples.japanese: {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{話|はな}しかける→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧。
examples.english: To talk to anyone and everyone.

examples.japanese: {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦かまわ→かまう：01212_kamau⟧ず⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こぼす→こぼす：02104_kobosu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people who complain to anyone who will listen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誰彼|だれかれ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好|す}かれている→好く：30762_suku⟧。
examples.english: She treats everyone kindly without exception, so everyone likes her.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧ (who) and ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧ (that person), meaning "this person and that person" — i.e., anyone without distinction. Most commonly appears in the pattern {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without regard to who).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: to anyone; indiscriminately
- {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦かまわ→かまう：01212_kamau⟧ず: without caring who; regardless of who
- {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: from various people; from no one in particular

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anyone; everybody — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: to anyone — similar meaning but more colloquial
- {不特定多数|ふとくていたすう}: unspecified large number of people — formal, often administrative

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary and formal. More common in written language than casual speech. The pattern {誰彼|だれかれ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ is the most frequently encountered usage.
